import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().execute();
    }

    private void execute() {
        try (InputReader in = new InputReader(System.in);
             OutputWriter out = new OutputWriter(System.out)) {
            GTakeMetro solver = new GTakeMetro();
            solver.solve(1, in, out);
        }
    }

    static class GTakeMetro {
        public void solve(int testNumber, InputReader in, OutputWriter out) {
            int n = in.nextInt(), m = in.nextInt();
            int s = in.nextInt() - 1;
            long t = in.nextLong();
            
            while (t > 0) {
                if (s < m) {
                    s = (int) ((s + t) % n);
                } else {
                    s = (int) ((s - t % n + n) % n);
                }
                t--;
            }
            
            out.println(s + 1);
        }
    }

    static class OutputWriter implements AutoCloseable {
        private final PrintWriter writer;

        public OutputWriter(OutputStream outputStream) {
            writer = new PrintWriter(new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream)));
        }

        public void close() {
            writer.close();
        }

        public void println(int i) {
            writer.println(i);
        }
    }

    static class InputReader {
        private final InputStream stream;
        private final byte[] buf = new byte[1 << 16];
        private int cur, len;

        public InputReader(InputStream stream) {
            this.stream = stream;
        }

        private int read() {
            if (len == -1) throw new InputMismatchException();
            if (cur >= len) {
                cur = 0;
                try {
                    len = stream.read(buf);
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    throw new InputMismatchException();
                }
                if (len <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buf[cur++];
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            int c;
            while ((c = read()) <= ' ') ;
            byte sign = 1;
            if (c == '-') {
                sign = -1;
                c = read();
            }
            int res = 0;
            while (c > ' ') {
                res = res * 10 + c - '0';
                c = read();
            }
            return res * sign;
        }

        public long nextLong() {
            int c;
            while ((c = read()) <= ' ') ;
            byte sign = 1;
            if (c == '-') {
                sign = -1;
                c = read();
            }
            long res = 0L;
            while (c > ' ') {
                res = res * 10L + c - '0';
                c = read();
            }
            return res * sign;
        }
    }
}
